set -euo pipefail; echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); echo APP_WINDOWS=$(DISPLAY=:0 wmctrl -lpGx 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'Google-chrome' || true); echo SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service 2>/dev/null || true); echo SENSOR_BEGIN; sensors 2>/dev/null | head -n 100 || true; echo SENSOR_END; python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image,ImageChops,ImageStat
from pathlib import Path
pairs=[('snarl_left','mund_keyframes/mund_22_snarl_left/stufe_00.png','mund_keyframes/mund_22_snarl_left/stufe_04.png'),('snarl_right','mund_keyframes/mund_23_snarl_right/stufe_00.png','mund_keyframes/mund_23_snarl_right/stufe_04.png'),('smirk_left','mund_keyframes/mund_31_smirk_left/stufe_00.png','mund_keyframes/mund_31_smirk_left/stufe_04.png'),('tongue_tip','mund_keyframes/mund_25_tongue_tip/stufe_00.png','mund_keyframes/mund_25_tongue_tip/stufe_04.png')]
for name,a,b in pairs:
 A=Image.open(a).convert('RGBA'); B=Image.open(b).convert('RGBA'); D=ImageChops.difference(A,B); bb=D.getbbox(); st=ImageStat.Stat(D); w,h=A.size
 print(name,'size=',A.size,'bbox=',bb,'bbox_norm=',None if not bb else tuple(round(v/(w if i%2==0 else h),4) for i,v in enumerate(bb)),'mean_rgba=',tuple(round(x,3) for x in st.mean))
 if bb:
  # report fraction of changed intensity in upper/middle/lower thirds of the mouth patch
  g=D.convert('L')
  for zone,(y0,y1) in {'upper':(0,h//3),'mid':(h//3,2*h//3),'lower':(2*h//3,h)}.items():
   z=g.crop((0,y0,w,y1)); s=sum(z.getdata()); print(' ',zone,'energy=',s)
print('PASSIVE_FORENSICS_PASS')
PY
